asr.full_text: You all know the tragic story about the submarine Kursk and a letter from captain Kolesnikov. Did the song start? Who will tell us the death of a couple of honest words? The captain Kolesnikov Write us a letter The pencil is broken It is cold and dark The captain Kolesnikov. . . He writes a letter The pencil is broken It is cold and dark The captain Kolesnikov writes to us And now he's gonna read just a sentence! It's no joke, it's a great song! This is how we're meant to be in such hard times There're just few left on my hungry back My three compartments are about to blow up Still got three under the water Although I know there's no salvation If you believe, wait You'll find my letter I know there is no salvation. But, if you trust, wait. You'll find my letters. They're in your book. I know we have no salvation. But, if you trust, wait! You'll find my letters. They're in your book. The Kursk grave is torn to pieces, It's frozen, it's pulled, It's cut into pieces for farewell, It's made of rusty ropes. And above the water, the seagulls of the ship Are gloomy. On the ground, a submarine sleeps, But how far to the ground. And above the water, the seagulls are gloomy Ships On the ground the submarine sleeps But how far to the ground After what happened They will lie for a long time Will the commission tell How hard it is to die Who of us are the same age? Who is a hero? Who is a scum? Captain Kolesnikov writes us a letter Who of us are the same age? Who is a hero? Who is a scum? Captain Kolesnikov writes us a letter. Come on, Vanya! ¶¶
